entries.claim: Task 2 directs the seam prose to say that a `worker_cache` fact carries “only” the stopped worker’s `agent_id` and cache figures, while also saying the renderer joins it on `corr` plus `agent_id`.
entries.failure_scenario: This publishes a false seam contract: PLAN-1 Task 5 requires every fact to carry `corr`, `phase`, `role`, and optionally `ts` in addition to `agent_id` and cache keys, and CONTEXT D-04 requires the real `phase` specifically so phase-filtered rendering can see it. Implementing the prose as specified omits material identity fields and leaves the hook description false immediately after the feature ships; retaining those fields contradicts the task’s “only” claim. Thus the required D-14 correction is not achievable as written.

entries.claim: Task 5 verifies the three withholding gates only through `closeForStop`’s returned event list; its sole hook-to-disk-to-render end-to-end check covers the already-closed gate.
entries.failure_scenario: AC1 requires each of not-terminal, already-closed, and two-open-dispatch to demonstrate both that no `return` is written and that its cache figures reach the record in a render. AC5 likewise requires brackets for terminal, not-terminal, and two-open cases to carry the transcript’s figures. The task’s not-terminal and two-open cases can pass even if their facts are not appended, are phase-filtered out, derive an unusable corr/phase, or fail to fold onto a bracket. Task 6’s live check only observes an unspecified `cad-verifier` bracket, not all gate paths. No task therefore proves the required rendered outcome for two of the three gates.
